title: Remediation of malachite green-laden wastewater by plant-loaded metal oxide nanocomposites
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32942-32955
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05373K, Paper

Chisom Theresa Umeh, John Kanayochukwu Nduka, Kovo Godfrey Akpomie, Amalachukwu Ifeyinwa Obi, Nkeiru Magdalene Akanbi
Nickel- and copper oxide-loaded Bryophyllum pinnatum (BP) nanocomposites (NiONPs-BP and CuONPs-BP) were prepared by a thermo-chemical precipitation process for sequestration of malachite green dye from a synthetically prepared aqueous solution.
